intro.text: A Lightweaver and a newer member of Shallan's Unseen Court.

items.text: Shortly before the singers occupied Urithiru, Darcira trained in swordplay and Lightweaving with Shallan and Beryl beneath the tower. Still unpractised, she was advised by Shallan not to let her illusions sway her actions too much. She was not chosen for the expedition to Lasting Integrity.
Darcira followed a suspected Ghostblood to Narak and reported the hideout to Shallan by spanreed.
During the raid, she helped intercept Ghostbloods fleeing through the back tunnels before reaching the wounded Shallan.

personality.text: Quiet, Darcira avoids crowds and likes to curl up and read, but like many Lightweavers she enjoys acting the part when wearing an illusion, and can turn bold, even reckless.
